questions.q: Why did the party sit down at the top of the slope?
choices: To recover from the alarm and rest Silver and the sick men
To eat the treasure they had found
questions.evidence: partly to rest Silver and the sick folk

questions.q: How many "tall trees" did Silver find in about the right line from Skeleton Island?
What song suddenly came from the trees?
choices: Fifteen men on the dead man's chest
questions.evidence: Fifteen men on the dead man's chest

questions.q: How did the pirates react when they heard the voice singing?
choices: They went pale with terror, and Morgan grovelled on the ground
They fired their guns into the trees
They ignored it and kept walking

questions.q: Why did the words "Fetch aft the rum, Darby!" terrify the pirates even more?
choices: Darby was the name of their ship
They meant the rum was gone

questions.q: What does Silver's speech about "seven hundred thousand pound" show about him?
choices: His greed was stronger than his fear
He did not believe in the treasure
He wanted to give up and go home
He was afraid of the dead
questions.evidence: I'll not be beat by man or devil

questions.q: What reasoning did Silver use to prove the voice was not a spirit?
choices: A spirit would not have an echo
Spirits only come out at night
questions.evidence: what's he doing with an echo to him

questions.q: Whose voice did Silver decide it really was?
Why did the pirates quickly lose their fear once they decided the voice was Ben Gunn's?
choices: Nobody cared about Ben Gunn, dead or alive
Ben Gunn had already left the island
questions.evidence: dead or alive, nobody minds him

questions.q: What was happening to Dick as they walked on?
choices: He was falling sick with the fever
He was finding gold on the path

questions.q: How was the third tall tree different from the first two?
choices: It was the right one, a giant nearly two hundred feet tall
It was the smallest of the three
It had the skeleton under it
questions.evidence: The third rose nearly two hundred feet into the air

questions.q: What did Jim believe Silver planned to do once he had the gold?
choices: Seize the ship at night, kill the honest men and sail away
Keep his promise to the doctor
Give the treasure to the squire
questions.evidence: cut every honest throat about that island

questions.q: As the gold grew near, Silver's "nostrils stood out and quivered." What does this show?
questions.evidence: his nostrils stood out and quivered

questions.q: What did the treasure hunters find when they reached the spot under the tree?
choices: An old dug-out pit with broken boards and no treasure
A chest full of gold coins
questions.evidence: Before us was a great excavation

questions.q: What name was branded on one of the boards in the pit?
What is the big surprise at the end of this chapter?
choices: The treasure has already been dug up and taken
The pirates find more gold than they expected
Silver is shot by Ben Gunn
questions.evidence: the seven hundred thousand pounds were gone!
